name: Chagrin Falls
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Chagrin Falls, OH 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Chagrin Falls, Ohio for 2026: Lighting of the Greens, Deck the Falls with Santa and a holiday concert, with dates checked on host sites.
lede: Chagrin Falls gathers around Triangle Park for the Lighting of the Greens and a pair of Deck the Falls Saturdays with Santa in the Bandstand.
celebrates: The Chagrin Valley Jaycees run the village's biggest holiday events. Lighting of the Greens on Black Friday brings a Santa Parade at 6 pm and the lighting of the Christmas tree in Triangle Park at 7 pm, according to the Jaycees. Deck the Falls, formerly Holly Hall, follows on two December Saturdays with Santa, balloon artists, cookies, cocoa and crafts. The village council also approved a menorah display at Triangle Park, lit at 7 pm from December 5 to 10, and Chagrin Valley Little Theatre closes the month with an orchestra concert.
lastyear: The Jaycees' Deck the Falls page includes a 2025 Outtakes photo gallery, with pictures from the December 2025 event. In 2026, the Jaycees again schedule two Saturdays, December 5 and 12, from 11 am to 3 pm, and the village announced its Lighting of the Greens traffic and parking plans for Black Friday.
facts: Chagrin Valley Little Theatre says it has been entertaining Northeast Ohio since 1930. Deck the Falls was formerly called Holly Hall, and earlier village calendars show Santa visits at Holly Hall in Chagrin Falls Township Hall at 83 North Main Street, the same hall named on this year's Deck the Falls page.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train that runs inside Chagrin Falls. Farther away, the Cuyahoga Valley Scenic Railroad runs a holiday North Pole Adventure on vintage trains through Cuyahoga Valley National Park between Independence and Akron, and the Lorain and West Virginia Railway runs Santa Trains with short coach and caboose rides in Wellington, according to Rally Takes the Train's Cleveland guide. Book early, since holiday trains fill up.

faq: How does Chagrin Falls celebrate Christmas?
The Chagrin Valley Jaycees hold the Lighting of the Greens with a Santa Parade and tree lighting, then Deck the Falls with Santa visits, crafts and cocoa on two Saturdays in December.
When is the Chagrin Falls Santa Parade?
The Jaycees list the Santa Parade at 6 pm on Friday, November 27, 2026, with the lighting ceremony at 7 pm in Triangle Park.
It is the Jaycees' holiday event, formerly called Holly Hall, with Santa, elf balloon artists, crafts, cookies and cocoa.
Is there a Christmas train in Chagrin Falls?
We did not find one. For a longer holiday ride, look to the Cuyahoga Valley Scenic Railroad.
